new_destinations.rationale: National park, therefore a destination. No kept sub-spots (all sights inside it were rejected as parts of the park). Span 30 km: the Big Guitar at Narrandera (32 km) and the Coleambally Dragline (30 km) are reached from their own towns, not the park.

review.name: Coleambally Wineglass Water Tower
review.reason: For: Wikivoyage describes a tiled wineglass water tower, a distinctive roadside landmark, 5-minute stop. Against: one source, a water tower in a tiny town, weaker than the dragline; owner call.

if_conditional_demoted: If Dunera Museum or Junee Licorice Factory cannot have hours verified in Pipeline C they move to review and are removed from hay / junee; the junee proposal then falls to two spots and should be declined.
